messages.subject: Moderation in SEM
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am very new to lavaan and am hoping that you can help me out.

I want to conduct an SEM in which I have several moderation effects. I only seem to find code examples for mediation, however, and for the moderation examples I do find, I don't quite understand how to include them in the SEM.
Is there any simple tutorial on moderation, similar to the one from the mediation totorial?

model <- '
# direct effect
Y ~ c*X
# mediator
M ~ a*X Y ~ b*M
# indirect effect
(a*b) ab := a*b
# total effect
total := c + (a*b)
'
fit <- sem(model, data = Data)
summary(fit)

Thank you so much for any help!
Best,
Daria
